title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
selection_reason: The abstract describes chunked KV-prefill reuse and sparse selection for diffusion LLMs, reducing per-step cost and reporting 9.1–28.0× speedups at 8K–32K contexts. This directly targets long-context inference latency and memory.
